system.description:
• Effect: You know three Metamagic options from the list below, and learn one more at 5th, 10th and 15th level.
  • When you cast a spell you may apply one option you know: burn 2 points with Spellburn for its base effect, or use a Wild Surge for its enhanced effect.
  • One option per spell (from 20th level, once a day, two, paying for each).
  • Spellburn: lower your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution by 2, your choice each time.
  • You burn your own score: a spell, potion, item or form that raises or sets the score gives you nothing more to burn, and burned points stay burned beneath it.
  • A burned score uses its lowered value for everything, Max HP and the death threshold included; if your HP is above your new maximum, it drops to it.
  • Spellburn can't take a score below 1 and never calls for a Corruption roll.
  • Recovery: after a long rest you regain 3 burned points in all, split as you choose (6 from 6th level). Nothing else restores them.
  • Wild Surge: once a day (twice from 5th level, four times from 15th), give a spell an option's enhanced effect at no cost in points.
  • The GM then rolls d20 in secret: on a 1, a Major Corruption; on 2 to 5, a Minor Corruption; on 6 or more, nothing, and the GM tells you the surge passed cleanly.
  • For a Corruption the GM rolls d100 on the Sorcerer's Corruption tables (Monsters & Treasure), which stay GM-only: you know something has shifted, not what.
  • What Corruption can do: a Minor Corruption is a small change that can be cosmetic, helpful or harmful, and may fade.
  • A Major Corruption is lasting.
  • For example: eyes that glow in the dark, frost on everything you touch, a voice that echoes, or a limb that withers.

activities.name: Spellburn
activities.text: Pay for a Metamagic option's base effect: lower your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution by 2, your choice each time. A burned score uses its lowered value for everything, Max HP and the death threshold included. Never below 1, and never a Corruption roll. After a long rest you regain 3 burned points in all (6 from 6th level), and by no other means.

activities.name: Wild Surge
activities.text: Give a spell a Metamagic option's enhanced effect at no cost in points. The GM then rolls d20 in secret (the Corruption roll below): 1 a Major Corruption, 2 to 5 a Minor Corruption, 6 or more nothing. Once a day, twice from 5th level, four times from 15th.

activities.name: Corruption roll
activities.text: After a Wild Surge: the GM's secret d20. 1: Major Corruption; 2 to 5: Minor Corruption; 6 or more: nothing (the GM tells you the surge passed cleanly). The GM's d100 on that table follows by itself (Monsters & Treasure, Sorcerer's Corruption).
